[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: since 2026-09-24 agent log entries may carry `localized` (message keys plus parameters, nested or verbatim lines; shared/domain/agent/agentMainText.ts, whose AGENT_MAIN_TEXT_IT is also the renderer's `agentMain` Italian locale) and the timeline renders them in the UI language (localizeAgentLog); the application closure summary is migrated. Still Italian only in the UI: the closure reason (ApplicationClosureRequest.reason is free text from about 15 guard call sites, e.g. 'Il modello richiede una decisione dell'utente prima di proseguire.'), the 'Diagnostica sessione' detail (renderDiagnosticDetail), the agent:done summary kept in executed prompts, about 70 other emitLog messages (agentOrchestratorToolResultProcessor.ts, agentOrchestratorCircuitBreakerAndVerification.ts, agentOrchestratorAskAutoHealing.ts), Main error strings such as sidecarAppService.ts 'ID documento non valido.' and sidecarHttpClient.ts 'Eliminazione scaduta...', and the session tracker markdown (sessionDebtTracker.ts). The Sidecar chunk prefix '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' is embedded in stored vectors. Next, give ApplicationClosureRequest a reason key for the guard call sites, then migrate the diagnostic detail and the agent:done summary (AgentDoneResult.localized), and leave the chunk prefix until a re-index migration exists. Open question for the user before extending it: confirm that the next slices reuse the same `localized` field of agent:log (additive, optional) and add AgentDoneResult.localized.

[P3] TEST-PLATFORM-01: the fast suite is verified on Windows only. On Linux (cloud container, no PowerShell, 2026-09-24) 35 tests in 16 files fail before and after every change: PersistentPowerShellSession, TaskRunner and the run_command/run_tests paths that spawn PowerShell (timeouts or success false), Windows path expectations (projectRegistryDomain deriveNameFromPath with 'D:\Projects\Alpha', contextFilter and agentOrchestratorSessionSetup protected directories, structuredCommandSafety), hardware-derived num_ctx (agentInterviewAppService, planGenerationAppService expect 8192, the container resolves 4096) and a 5 s timeout in tokenEstimate cache bounds. Next, decide whether these tests should inject the platform, hardware profile and shell (so they run everywhere) or declare themselves Windows-only with a visible reason; never skip them silently. The four Electron E2E scripts (scripts/e2e/*.mjs) launch node_modules/electron/dist/electron.exe, so no E2E runs off Windows either.

[P3] DEADCODE-AUDIT-01: `npm run audit:deadcode` (knip) counts test files as entries, so modules imported only by their own tests survived (six were removed on 2026-09-24, among them three session repositories and modelIntentClassifier). `knip --production` currently reports every dependency unused because no entry is marked production (`!`). Next, mark the production entries in knip.json and run the production mode in audit:deadcode; also decide on src/lib/errors AppError, which no production code constructs.

[P3] IPC-CONTRACT-01: each of the ~97 IPC channels is written four times: the channel string and positional arguments in electron/preload.ts, the IElectronAPI signature in shared/types, the handler and zod schema in electron/core/presentation, kept aligned by scripts/check_ipc_registration.mjs. Next, one typed channel map in shared/ (channel -> argument object and result) that the preload, the handlers and the Renderer types derive from, with object parameters instead of long positional lists (ingestFile takes 8). This changes the preload contract, so confirm with the user first.

[P3] AGENT-GUARD-GROWTH-01: electron/core/domain/agent holds ~60 modules (9.8k lines) and the agentOrchestrator* phases ~8k lines; most guards and directives were added one per failure class seen in live runs. guardEvents already records every firing. Next, report per-guard firing counts across live runs and retire guards that never fire or never change the outcome, before adding new ones.

[P3] SHELL-PATHS-01: commands run through three mechanisms: node-pty in taskRunner.executePowerShellCommand, its child_process fallback when node-pty fails to load or spawn, and PersistentPowerShellSession for the agent tools. Next, decide on one mechanism for the agent and the UI terminal and remove the others.

Next, either document that Application may depend on Infrastructure adapters, or add ports only where a second implementation (tests) exists; do not add ports for their own sake.
